notes: Phase 3 of Expander Icon and Positions: Accessibility and Polish. Phase 3 was primarily a verification phase — all accessibility attributes (aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-label, aria-haspopup) were already correctly implemented in Phases 1 and 2. World-review caught 2 critical issues (FAB focus outline invisible due to same-color-as-background, FAB icon span missing aria-hidden), 1 warning (missing reduced motion for sidebar float buttons), and 1 suggestion (desktop toggle touch target 40px -> 44px). All 4 issues fixed and verified with new tests. Verified aria-haspopup=dialog is correct since bottom sheet has role=dialog.
